meaning_en: All praise is due to Allah
deep_meaning: The root H-M-D means to praise, to commend, to acknowledge goodness. When you say Alhamdulillah, you are not only thanking Allah. You are declaring that all praise belongs to Him, in every state, in every moment.
why_this_phrase: Surah Al-Fatiha begins with Alhamdulillah. It is the first word of the Book. It is the response to every blessing, and it belongs in every moment. The Quran uses it in moments of gratitude, and in moments of completion.

verses.translation_en: All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
verses.context: The opening of the Quran, and the first thing said in the Book.

verses.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي وَهَبَ لِي عَلَى الْكِبَرِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ
verses.translation_en: Praise be to Allah, who has granted me in old age Ismail and Ishaq.
verses.context: Ibrahim's words of gratitude after receiving children in old age.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translation_en: And they said, 'Praise be to Allah, who has favored us over many of His believing servants.'
verses.context: Dawud and Sulaiman, after Allah gave them knowledge and wisdom. They said it in gratitude.

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ
verses.translation_en: And they will say, 'Praise be to Allah, who has removed from us sorrow.'
verses.context: The words of the people of Paradise, when they enter it.

verses.arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
verses.translation_en: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
verses.context: Gratitude is linked to remembrance in the same verse.

verses.translation_en: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you.
verses.context: Allah declared this to Musa's people. It came after the command to remember His favors. (14:6-7)

verses.arabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَا
verses.translation_en: And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them.

when_to_say.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي وَهَبَ لِي عَلَى الْكِبَرِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ
when_to_say.translation_en: Praise be to Allah, who has granted me in old age Ismail and Ishaq.

when_to_say.moment: When you reflect on His favors
when_to_say.translation_en: All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
